title: Editing a tag group: menu actions, filled-in window, hover and success
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • A tag group (for example "Service Team" with at least one Member, for example "Ashlee Thomas"; Public off, or on for a public group).
custom_steps:
1. On a group you own (and a public group as an admin), read the Edit and Delete actions on its row.
  2. Hover a row.
  3. Open Edit and read the dialog title and prefilled fields; save and read the success message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The owner of a group, or any admin when the group is public, sees Edit and Delete actions on its row; hovering a row shows every member's name.
  • Edit opens the same dialog titled "Edit tag group", filled in with the group's name, members and visibility; saving confirms with "Tag group updated".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R15: “The owner of a group, or any admin when the group is public, sees Edit and Delete actions on its row.”
  • S6-R16: “Edit opens the same dialog titled "Edit tag group".”
  • S6-R17: “Saving an edit confirms with the success message "Tag group updated".”
  • S6-R24: “Hovering a row shows every member's name.”
  • S6-R25: “The "Edit tag group" dialog opens with the group's name, members and visibility already filled in.”
